```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(leaflet)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(htmltools)

BUCKET_URL <- "https://storage.googleapis.com/ncrmp-atlantic-photos/MIR"
PLOT_ZOOM_LEVEL <- 11

mir_habitat_colors <- c(
  "Backreef"                 = "#E85B55",
  "Deep Boulder Coral"       = "#002D54",
  "Deep Reef"                = "#245899",
  "Dense Palmata Framework"  = "#0087A4",
  "Forereef Terrace"         = "#49C5B6",
  "Patch Reef"               = "#F48CC5",
  "Reef Crest"               = "#FAA53D",
  "Shallow Boulder Coral"    = "#BF0D3E",
  "Shallow Reef Crest"       = "#E83258",
  "Spur and Groove - Sides"   = "#A4CD39",
  "Spur and Groove - Top"     = "#48BC46"
)

reefs <- read.csv(
  "gitignore/data/reefs.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  na.strings = c("", "NA", "N/A")
)
plots <- read.csv(
  "gitignore/data/plots.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  na.strings = c("", "NA", "N/A")
)
maps <- read.csv(
  "gitignore/data/maps.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  na.strings = c("", "NA", "N/A")
)

check_columns <- function(data, required, filename) {
  missing <- setdiff(required, names(data))
  if (length(missing)) {
    stop(filename, " is missing columns: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }
}

check_columns(reefs, c("reef_name", "reef_abb", "lat", "lon"), "reefs.csv")
check_columns(plots, c("reef_name", "plot_id", "lat", "lon", "habitat"), "plots.csv")
check_columns(
  maps,
  c("map_id", "plot_id", "date", "timepoint", "available"),
  "maps.csv"
)

# Ignore blank trailing rows; habitat may be missing.
plots <- plots[
  complete.cases(plots[c("reef_name", "plot_id", "lat", "lon")]),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

if (!nrow(reefs)) stop("reefs.csv must contain at least one reef.")
if (!nrow(plots)) stop("plots.csv must contain at least one plot.")

reefs$lat <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(reefs$lat))
reefs$lon <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(reefs$lon))
plots$lat <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(plots$lat))
plots$lon <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(plots$lon))

if (any(!is.finite(reefs$lat)) || any(!is.finite(reefs$lon))) {
  stop("Every reef in reefs.csv must have numeric lat and lon coordinates.")
}
if (any(!is.finite(plots$lat)) || any(!is.finite(plots$lon))) {
  stop("Every plot in plots.csv must have numeric lat and lon coordinates.")
}
if (anyDuplicated(reefs$reef_name)) {
  stop("reef_name values must be unique in reefs.csv.")
}
if (any(!plots$reef_name %in% reefs$reef_name)) {
  stop("Every plots.csv reef_name must match a reef_name in reefs.csv.")
}

# Repeated plot rows are allowed only when their details agree.
plot_fields <- c("reef_name", "lat", "lon", "habitat")
plot_groups <- split(plots, plots$plot_id)
conflicting_plot_ids <- names(Filter(
  function(group) nrow(unique(group[, plot_fields, drop = FALSE])) > 1,
  plot_groups
))

if (length(conflicting_plot_ids)) {
  stop(
    "These plot_id values have conflicting reef, coordinates, or habitat in plots.csv: ",
    paste(conflicting_plot_ids, collapse = ", "),
    ". Keep one consistent row per plot_id."
  )
}

# Keep one row per plot so each plot has one marker.
plots <- plots[!duplicated(plots$plot_id), , drop = FALSE]

if (any(!maps$plot_id %in% plots$plot_id)) {
  stop("Every maps.csv plot_id must match a plot_id in plots.csv.")
}

maps$available <- toupper(trimws(as.character(maps$available)))
if (anyNA(maps$available) || any(!maps$available %in% c("Y", "N"))) {
  stop("maps.csv available values must be Y or N.")
}

plot_data <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(plots)), function(i) {
  plot <- plots[i, ]
  plot_maps <- maps[maps$plot_id == plot$plot_id, , drop = FALSE]

  map_items <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(plot_maps)), function(j) {
    item <- plot_maps[j, ]
    list(
      map_id = as.character(item$map_id),
      date = as.character(item$date),
      timepoint = as.character(item$timepoint),
      available = item$available == "Y"
    )
  })

  list(
    id = as.character(plot$plot_id),
    name = as.character(plot$plot_id),
    reef_name = as.character(plot$reef_name),
    habitat = if (is.na(plot$habitat)) "" else as.character(plot$habitat),
    lat = plot$lat,
    lon = plot$lon,
    maps = map_items
  )
})

reef_data <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(reefs)), function(i) {
  reef <- reefs[i, ]

  reef_plots <- plot_data[vapply(
    plot_data,
    function(plot) identical(plot$reef_name, as.character(reef$reef_name)),
    logical(1)
  )]

  list(
    id = as.character(reef$reef_abb),
    name = as.character(reef$reef_name),
    lat = reef$lat,
    lon = reef$lon,
    plots = reef_plots
  )
})

main_map <- leaflet(width = "100%", height = "70vh") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery) %>%
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    colors = c(unname(mir_habitat_colors), "#9ca3af"),
    labels = c(names(mir_habitat_colors), "Unknown / N/A"),
    title = "Plot habitat",
    opacity = 1
  ) %>%
  fitBounds(
    lng1 = min(reefs$lon),
    lat1 = min(reefs$lat),
    lng2 = max(reefs$lon),
    lat2 = max(reefs$lat)
  ) %>%
  htmlwidgets::onRender(
    r"(
    function(el, x, data) {
      const map = this;
      const reefs = [].concat(data.reefs || []);
      const plotLayer = L.layerGroup();
      const selectedPlot = document.getElementById('selected-plot');
      const selectedHabitat = document.getElementById('selected-habitat');
      const timepoints = document.getElementById('timepoints');
      const backButton = document.getElementById('back-to-reefs');

      function updatePlotVisibility() {
        if (map.getZoom() >= data.plotZoomLevel) {
          if (!map.hasLayer(plotLayer)) plotLayer.addTo(map);
        } else if (map.hasLayer(plotLayer)) {
          map.removeLayer(plotLayer);
        }
      }

      function bucketUrl(filename) {
        const encoded = filename.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/');
        return data.bucket.replace(/\/$/, '') + '/' + encoded;
      }

      function renderTimepoints(plot) {
        timepoints.replaceChildren();

        const maps = [].concat(plot.maps || []);

        if (!maps.length) {
          timepoints.textContent = 'No timepoints are listed for this plot.';
          return;
        }

        timepoints.style.width = '100%';
        timepoints.style.display = 'grid';
        timepoints.style.gridTemplateColumns =
          'repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))';
        timepoints.style.gap = '16px';

        maps.forEach(function(item) {
          const card = document.createElement('section');
          card.style.border = '1px solid #ccc';
          card.style.padding = '12px';

          const caption = document.createElement('p');
          caption.textContent =
            'Date: ' + (item.date || 'N/A') +
            ' — Timepoint: ' + (item.timepoint || 'N/A');
          card.appendChild(caption);

          if (!item.available) {
            const unavailable = document.createElement('p');
            unavailable.textContent = 'N/A (not in bucket)';
            card.appendChild(unavailable);
            timepoints.appendChild(card);
            return;
          }

          let scale = 1;
          let offsetX = 0;
          let offsetY = 0;
          let dragging = false;
          let dragStartX = 0;
          let dragStartY = 0;

          const controls = document.createElement('div');
          controls.style.display = 'flex';
          controls.style.gap = '8px';
          controls.style.marginBottom = '8px';

          const viewport = document.createElement('div');
          viewport.style.height = 'min(75vh, 900px)';
          viewport.style.minHeight = '420px';
          viewport.style.width = '100%';
          viewport.style.overflow = 'hidden';
          viewport.style.background = '#f3f4f6';
          viewport.style.touchAction = 'none';
          viewport.style.cursor = 'default';

          const image = document.createElement('img');
          image.alt = item.map_id + ' map';
          image.draggable = false;
          image.style.width = '100%';
          image.style.height = '100%';
          image.style.objectFit = 'contain';
          image.style.transformOrigin = 'center center';
          image.style.userSelect = 'none';

          const imageStatus = document.createElement('p');
          imageStatus.textContent = 'Loading ' + item.map_id + '.jpg…';

          const zoomOut = document.createElement('button');
          zoomOut.type = 'button';
          zoomOut.textContent = '−';
          zoomOut.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Zoom out');

          const zoomIn = document.createElement('button');
          zoomIn.type = 'button';
          zoomIn.textContent = '+';
          zoomIn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Zoom in');

          const resetZoom = document.createElement('button');
          resetZoom.type = 'button';
          resetZoom.textContent = 'Reset zoom';

          function updateImageTransform() {
            image.style.transform =
              'translate(' + offsetX + 'px, ' + offsetY + 'px) scale(' + scale + ')';
            viewport.style.cursor = scale > 1 ? 'grab' : 'default';
          }

          function zoom(factor) {
            scale = Math.max(1, Math.min(5, scale * factor));
            if (scale === 1) {
              offsetX = 0;
              offsetY = 0;
            }
            updateImageTransform();
          }

          zoomOut.addEventListener('click', function() {
            zoom(1 / 1.25);
          });

          zoomIn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            zoom(1.25);
          });

          resetZoom.addEventListener('click', function() {
            scale = 1;
            offsetX = 0;
            offsetY = 0;
            updateImageTransform();
          });

          viewport.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(event) {
            if (scale === 1) return;
            dragging = true;
            dragStartX = event.clientX - offsetX;
            dragStartY = event.clientY - offsetY;
            viewport.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
            viewport.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
          });

          viewport.addEventListener('pointermove', function(event) {
            if (!dragging) return;
            offsetX = event.clientX - dragStartX;
            offsetY = event.clientY - dragStartY;
            updateImageTransform();
            viewport.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
          });

          function stopDragging() {
            dragging = false;
            viewport.style.cursor = scale > 1 ? 'grab' : 'default';
          }

          viewport.addEventListener('pointerup', stopDragging);
          viewport.addEventListener('pointercancel', stopDragging);

          image.onload = function() {
            imageStatus.textContent = item.map_id + '.jpg loaded.';
          };

          image.onerror = function() {
            console.error('JPG request failed:', image.src);
            imageStatus.textContent =
              'Could not load JPG. Check the filename and bucket access.';
          };

          image.src = bucketUrl(item.map_id + '.jpg');

          controls.appendChild(zoomOut);
          controls.appendChild(zoomIn);
          controls.appendChild(resetZoom);
          viewport.appendChild(image);
          card.appendChild(controls);
          card.appendChild(viewport);
          card.appendChild(imageStatus);
          timepoints.appendChild(card);
        });
      }

      function selectPlot(plot) {
        selectedPlot.textContent = plot.name;
        selectedHabitat.textContent = 'Habitat: ' + (plot.habitat || 'N/A');
        renderTimepoints(plot);
      }

      function showReefPlots(reef) {
        const plots = [].concat(reef.plots || []);

        selectedPlot.textContent = reef.name;
        selectedHabitat.textContent = '';
        timepoints.textContent =
          'Zoom in to see plot markers, then select a plot.';

        if (plots.length === 1) {
          map.setView([Number(plots[0].lat), Number(plots[0].lon)], 13);
        } else if (plots.length > 1) {
          map.fitBounds(
            L.latLngBounds(plots.map(function(plot) {
              return [Number(plot.lat), Number(plot.lon)];
            })).pad(0.25),
            { maxZoom: 13 }
          );
        } else {
          map.setView([Number(reef.lat), Number(reef.lon)], 12);
          timepoints.textContent = 'No plots are listed for this reef.';
        }

        backButton.hidden = false;
      }

      reefs.forEach(function(reef) {
        L.circleMarker([Number(reef.lat), Number(reef.lon)], {
          radius: 12,
          color: '#ffffff',
          weight: 2,
          fillColor: '#06b6d4',
          fillOpacity: 0.95
        })
          .bindTooltip(reef.name)
          .on('click', function() {
            showReefPlots(reef);
          })
          .addTo(map);

        [].concat(reef.plots || []).forEach(function(plot) {
          const color = data.habitatColors[plot.habitat] || '#9ca3af';
          const hasAvailableMap = [].concat(plot.maps || []).some(function(item) {
            return item.available;
          });
          const icon = L.divIcon({
            className: '',
            html:
              '<div style="width:12px;height:12px;background-color:' +
              color +
              ';border:' +
              (hasAvailableMap ? '3px solid black' : '1px solid white') +
              ';box-sizing:border-box"></div>',
            iconSize: [14, 14],
            iconAnchor: [7, 7]
          });

          L.marker([Number(plot.lat), Number(plot.lon)], { icon: icon })
            .bindTooltip(plot.name + ' — ' + (plot.habitat || 'N/A'))
            .on('click', function() {
              selectPlot(plot);
            })
            .addTo(plotLayer);
        });
      });

      map.on('zoomend', updatePlotVisibility);
      updatePlotVisibility();

      if (reefs.length) {
        map.fitBounds(
          L.latLngBounds(reefs.map(function(reef) {
            return [Number(reef.lat), Number(reef.lon)];
          })),
          { maxZoom: 9 }
        );
      }

      backButton.addEventListener('click', function() {
        selectedPlot.textContent = '';
        selectedHabitat.textContent = '';
        timepoints.textContent =
          'Click a reef marker, then zoom in to see its plots.';
        backButton.hidden = true;

        if (reefs.length) {
          map.fitBounds(
            L.latLngBounds(reefs.map(function(reef) {
              return [Number(reef.lat), Number(reef.lon)];
            })),
            { maxZoom: 9 }
          );
        }
      });
    }
    )",
    data = list(
      reefs = reef_data,
      bucket = BUCKET_URL,
      plotZoomLevel = PLOT_ZOOM_LEVEL,
      habitatColors = as.list(mir_habitat_colors)
    )
  )

tagList(
  tags$h3("1. Regional Overview Map"),
  tags$p("Click a reef marker or zoom in to see plot markers."),
  main_map,
  tags$hr(),
  tags$h3("2. Plot JPGs"),
  tags$p("Maps available: CFN_CA-1 CHCA_CC-1, EDR_R5-3, SOMB_R3-2"),
  tags$button(
    id = "back-to-reefs",
    type = "button",
    hidden = NA,
    "Back to reefs"
  ),
  tags$h4(id = "selected-plot"),
  tags$p(id = "selected-habitat"),
  tags$div(
    id = "timepoints",
    "Click a reef marker or zoom in to see its plots."
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

BENTHIC_FILE <- "gitignore/data/vpi_data_community_cover.csv"

benthic <- read.csv(
  BENTHIC_FILE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  na.strings = c("", "NA", "N/A"),
  check.names = FALSE
)

required <- c(
  "site", "plot", "year", "index", "survey_type",
  "habitat_type", "group", "count", "n_points"
)
missing <- setdiff(required, names(benthic))
if (length(missing)) {
  stop("Benthic CSV is missing columns: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
}

# Combine the site abbreviation and plot label to match plot IDs elsewhere.
benthic$site <- trimws(as.character(benthic$site))
benthic$plot <- trimws(as.character(benthic$plot))
benthic$plot_id <- paste(benthic$site, benthic$plot, sep = "_")

# Give the source columns descriptive names for the charts.
benthic$map_id <- trimws(as.character(benthic$index))
benthic$timepoint <- trimws(as.character(benthic$survey_type))

for (column in c("year", "habitat_type", "group")) {
  benthic[[column]] <- trimws(as.character(benthic[[column]]))
}

benthic$count <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(benthic$count))
benthic$n_points <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(benthic$n_points))

# Remove blank rows and records that cannot contribute to cover estimates.
benthic <- benthic[
  complete.cases(benthic[c(
    "site", "plot_id", "year", "map_id", "timepoint",
    "habitat_type", "group", "count", "n_points"
  )]) &
    is.finite(benthic$count) &
    is.finite(benthic$n_points) &
    benthic$n_points > 0,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

if (!nrow(benthic)) {
  stop("The benthic CSV has no complete rows with positive n_points.")
}

# Summarize each plot map by benthic group.
plot_summary <- aggregate(
  cbind(count, n_points) ~
    site + plot_id + year + map_id + timepoint + habitat_type + group,
  data = benthic,
  FUN = sum
)
plot_summary$percent <- 100 * plot_summary$count / plot_summary$n_points
plot_summary$x_label <- paste(
  plot_summary$year,
  plot_summary$map_id,
  plot_summary$timepoint,
  plot_summary$habitat_type,
  sep = " / "
)

# Pool counts and sample sizes across plots for reef-level percentages.
reef_summary <- aggregate(
  cbind(count, n_points) ~
    site + year + timepoint + habitat_type + group,
  data = benthic,
  FUN = sum
)
reef_summary$percent <- 100 * reef_summary$count / reef_summary$n_points
reef_summary$x_label <- paste(
  reef_summary$year,
  reef_summary$timepoint,
  sep = " / "
)

# Count each plot once per reef, year, timepoint, and habitat.
reef_plot_counts <- unique(
  benthic[c("site", "year", "timepoint", "habitat_type", "plot_id")]
)
reef_plot_counts <- aggregate(
  plot_id ~ site + year + timepoint + habitat_type,
  data = reef_plot_counts,
  FUN = length
)
names(reef_plot_counts)[names(reef_plot_counts) == "plot_id"] <- "plot_count"

plot_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(
  plot_summary[c("plot_id", "x_label", "group", "percent")],
  dataframe = "rows",
  auto_unbox = FALSE,
  na = "null"
)

reef_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(
  reef_summary[c("site", "habitat_type", "x_label", "group", "percent")],
  dataframe = "rows",
  auto_unbox = FALSE,
  na = "null"
)

plot_count_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(
  reef_plot_counts,
  dataframe = "rows",
  auto_unbox = FALSE,
  na = "null"
)

tagList(
  tags$h3("3. Benthic Cover"),

  tags$h4("Individual plot"),
  tags$label(`for` = "benthic-plot-select", "Plot: "),
  tags$select(id = "benthic-plot-select"),
  tags$div(id = "benthic-plot-chart", style = "height: 450px;"),

  tags$h4("Reef-level benthic cover"),
  tags$label(`for` = "benthic-reef-select", "Reef: "),
  tags$select(id = "benthic-reef-select"),
  tags$label(`for` = "benthic-habitat-select", " Habitat: "),
  tags$select(id = "benthic-habitat-select"),
  tags$div(id = "benthic-reef-chart", style = "height: 450px;"),
  tags$h5("Number of plots per timepoint"),
  tags$div(id = "reef-plot-count-table"),

  tags$script(src = "https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-2.35.2.min.js"),

  tags$script(HTML(paste0(
    "const plotRows = ", as.character(plot_json), ";\n",
    "const reefRows = ", as.character(reef_json), ";\n",
    "const plotCountRows = ", as.character(plot_count_json), ";\n",
    r"(
    const plotSelect = document.getElementById('benthic-plot-select');
    const reefSelect = document.getElementById('benthic-reef-select');
    const habitatSelect = document.getElementById('benthic-habitat-select');

    function setOptions(select, values) {
      select.replaceChildren();
      values.forEach(function(value) {
        const option = document.createElement('option');
        option.value = value;
        option.textContent = value;
        select.appendChild(option);
      });
    }

    function uniqueSorted(values) {
      return Array.from(new Set(values)).sort();
    }

    function renderPlotChart() {
      const rows = plotRows.filter(function(row) {
        return row.plot_id === plotSelect.value;
      });

      const groups = uniqueSorted(rows.map(function(row) {
        return row.group;
      }));

      const traces = groups.map(function(group) {
        const groupRows = rows.filter(function(row) {
          return row.group === group;
        });

        return {
          type: 'bar',
          name: group,
          x: groupRows.map(function(row) { return row.x_label; }),
          y: groupRows.map(function(row) { return row.percent; }),
          hovertemplate: '%{x}<br>' + group + ': %{y:.1f}%<extra></extra>'
        };
      });

      Plotly.react('benthic-plot-chart', traces, {
        barmode: 'stack',
        title: 'Benthic cover by map and timepoint',
        xaxis: { title: 'Year / map / timepoint / habitat', automargin: true },
        yaxis: { title: 'Cover (%)' },
        legend: { title: { text: 'Benthic group' } },
        margin: { t: 55, b: 110, l: 60, r: 20 }
      }, { responsive: true });
    }

    function updateHabitatOptions() {
      const habitats = uniqueSorted(
        reefRows
          .filter(function(row) { return row.site === reefSelect.value; })
          .map(function(row) { return row.habitat_type; })
      );
      setOptions(habitatSelect, habitats);
    }

    function renderPlotCountTable() {
      const container = document.getElementById('reef-plot-count-table');
      const rows = plotCountRows.filter(function(row) {
        return row.site === reefSelect.value &&
          row.habitat_type === habitatSelect.value;
      });

      container.replaceChildren();

      if (!rows.length) {
        container.textContent = 'No plot counts for this selection.';
        return;
      }

      const table = document.createElement('table');
      table.className = 'table';

      const header = table.insertRow();
      ['Year', 'Timepoint', 'Number of plots'].forEach(function(text) {
        const cell = document.createElement('th');
        cell.textContent = text;
        header.appendChild(cell);
      });

      rows.forEach(function(row) {
        const tr = table.insertRow();
        [row.year, row.timepoint, row.plot_count].forEach(function(value) {
          tr.insertCell().textContent = value;
        });
      });

      container.appendChild(table);
    }

    function renderReefChart() {
      const rows = reefRows.filter(function(row) {
        return row.site === reefSelect.value &&
          row.habitat_type === habitatSelect.value;
      });

      const groups = uniqueSorted(rows.map(function(row) {
        return row.group;
      }));

      const traces = groups.map(function(group) {
        const groupRows = rows.filter(function(row) {
          return row.group === group;
        });

        return {
          type: 'bar',
          name: group,
          x: groupRows.map(function(row) { return row.x_label; }),
          y: groupRows.map(function(row) { return row.percent; }),
          hovertemplate: '%{x}<br>' + group + ': %{y:.1f}%<extra></extra>'
        };
      });

      Plotly.react('benthic-reef-chart', traces, {
        barmode: 'stack',
        title: 'Reef-level cover: ' + habitatSelect.value,
        xaxis: { title: 'Year / timepoint', automargin: true },
        yaxis: { title: 'Cover (%)' },
        legend: { title: { text: 'Benthic group' } },
        margin: { t: 55, b: 80, l: 60, r: 20 }
      }, { responsive: true });

      renderPlotCountTable();
    }

    setOptions(plotSelect, uniqueSorted(plotRows.map(function(row) {
      return row.plot_id;
    })));
    setOptions(reefSelect, uniqueSorted(reefRows.map(function(row) {
      return row.site;
    })));

    plotSelect.addEventListener('change', renderPlotChart);
    reefSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
      updateHabitatOptions();
      renderReefChart();
    });
    habitatSelect.addEventListener('change', renderReefChart);

    if (plotSelect.options.length) renderPlotChart();
    if (reefSelect.options.length) {
      updateHabitatOptions();
      renderReefChart();
    }
    )"
  )))
)
```
